name: Disable UWP Swapfile
description: Disables the UWP swap file used by some Store apps to reduce background virtual memory usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables the UWP swap file used by some Store apps to reduce background virtual memory usage.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Swapdatei für einige Store-Apps, um den Hintergrundvirtualspeicherverbrauch zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le fichier d'échange des applications du magasin pour réduire l'utilisation de la mémoire virtuelle en arrière-plan.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value SwapfileControl under HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management to set it to 0
